quests.title: Danger Lurks Everywhere in Fontaine

dialogue.t: The aquabus is just over there... We'll board together in a bit.
...Hey! Why are you crouching on the ground holding your head?
Did you hit your head or something? But there isn't anything here to hit your head on...
Shh! Get over here! Lie down next to me! It's dangerous here...
Here we go again...
This aquabus doesn't have any kind of barrier on top! If you place two poles on either side, and run fishing line between them...
Then when the aquabus passes through, that fishing line will suddenly become a knife that...
Aaaah! Stop! Don't say any more!
No, no, you don't even need two poles! One would be enough...
And if you hung up some fishing line on it, with the hook just dangling there...
Then the people on the aquabus would naturally be hooked, and left hanging in the air, and then...
Not listening not listening not listening... Paimon's not listening, lalalala!
After listening to her this whole time, even Paimon's getting kinda scared...
Let's get off the aquabus as soon as we arrive at the station, alright?
Why are you hiding again? There's nothing around here!
Can't you see that Gardemek? It's right in front of us!
Shh! Quick, get out of there! What if it goes out of control?
Or maybe its... its power core will suddenly explode! Or someone controlling it remotely will use it to attack us?

dialogue.sit: It looks completely normal to me.

dialogue.t: That is exactly what makes me so scared! A meka that is operating normally suddenly losing control, and some poor unfortunate sop suddenly losing their life...
Nobody would even be held responsible for such a thing! Perhaps the true culprit would never be found... No, it's simply too dangerous!
It already left, you can come out now!
Phew... It didn't go out of control, truly unexpected. Our lives have been spared yet again.

dialogue.sit: That kind of accident just isn't possible.
It wasn't going to go berserk in the first place, capeesh?

dialogue.t: What I was thinking of, was more of an "intentional accident."
Wait. But criminal events without a culprit... A crime that no individual will be held solely responsible for...
That's it! Inspiration has struck! Quickly, quickly, to the café! I must write this down!
Hey! Slow down, aren't you worried someone'll toss a rock and trip you or something?
Ah, right... That's true...
Well, thank you, {NICKNAME}. And thank you for escorting me here.
You say "escort," but all we did was walk with you here. We didn't do anything!
Yes. It appears I really was overthinking it...
This coffee is really great, haha... ha...
...So, do you think it's poisoned?

dialogue.sit: Would it kill you not to say things like that for two seconds!?

dialogue.t: Stop saying that kind of baloney! We finished drinking already, and we're fine, right?
No, no, no, perhaps it is a... special sort of poisoning.
First, the poisoner mixes a kind of medicine into our coffee.
Drinking that medicine alone will have no effect whatsoever on the victim.
After we have finished our poisoned drinks and gone home, the poisoner will follow us...
And as we sleep, he will enter our room, and mix a second kind of medicine into your water bottle.
The next day, after you're out and about, you'll take a drink from your water bottle. Then, the two medicines will mix and react within your body.
And then we'll...
My dear customer, just what are you saying?
Coffee? Poisoned? Please do not make such jests in my establishment!
Should your japes affect the other customers, I shall have to ask you to leave!

dialogue.sit: You explain Guijarro's situation to Arouet. After listening, he leaves, exasperated...
By way of apology, Guijarro buys another three cups of coffee...

dialogue.t: You watched him make the coffee this time! There's no way there could be a problem with it.
I know, I know, but... I did find a lot of inspiration along the way.
If I just put it all together, I'm sure I can think of how the perfect crime — one that leaves no trace — could be committed!
After I finish writing the book, I'll be sure to send you a copy.
But before that, let me finish this cup of coffee, this cup... of coffee...
Uh, {NICKNAME}, do you think... Is it at all possible...
Could this cup itself have poison on it!?

quests.description: You encounter an odd person beside an aquabus line near the Court of Fontaine…
